scope: C1 original WebArena snapshot integrity only

axes.novelty: legacy novelty mapped to canonical coverage/constructs, score 7 held
axes.calibration: score 8 held; design and empirical rejection evidence kept distinct

authority.manifest_digest_status: measured with sha256sum; no audit detector run
authority.source_pin_status: literal values read from manifest; source bodies not opened or independently rehashed by this seat
authority.selected_ids_scope: frozen baseline identity check, not a new integrity contract for the unlisted selection file

defect_under_challenge.description: Treat caller-editable manifest values as the sole snapshot authority, bypassing an independently persisted original manifest or complete original file-map pin.
defect_under_challenge.smallest_proposed_code_mutation: Disable only the independent original-pin rejection predicate, retaining ordinary per-manifest file hashing and missing-file handling. No implementation location was inspected or mutated.

detector_design.normalization_contract: Extract process status, stable finding codes, whether a success-class audit was emitted, and for the pristine case the declared population and ordered selection. These are witness predicates, not claimed production JSON key names.
detector_design.failure_gate: Exit 2 with the required stable finding, not exit 1 benchmark findings, a traceback, a timeout, or a success-class task/scorer inventory. Diagnostic pin metadata and explicitly unevaluated counters are permitted.
expectations_must_not_be_derived_from: independent oracle counts adjusted after comparison
detector_design.new_payload_hash_use: A recomputed hash may be written into a mutated manifest only to construct C2. It never replaces the expected original hash or the fixed expected result.
detector_design.code_triple_verdict_rule: Baseline suite failure is INCONCLUSIVE. Baseline PASS, mutant suite failure on the required integrity witness, and restored suite PASS kills M1. A completed mutant suite PASS is SURVIVED. Missing restored PASS or exact restoration evidence prevents a completed kill claim. No such suite was run here.

cases.mutation: None; complete copy of the four original pinned files, manifest and selected-task-ids.json under an isolated lane-shaped root.

cases.parameter: Each path in authority.expected_file_map separately, resetting the entire witness between instances.
cases.mutation: Append exactly one LF byte (0x0a) to the selected pinned file; manifest and every other file remain byte-identical. No upstream source is executed. JSON and Python parsing semantics should be unchanged by the extra trailing newline.
cases.expected_byte_relation: selected size = original size + 1; selected digest differs; manifest digest equals original

cases.parameter: Each path in authority.expected_file_map separately, resetting the entire witness between instances.
cases.mutation: Make only the selected copied file absent; leave its original manifest record present. Preserve its original bytes outside the witness for exact restoration.
cases.expected_byte_relation: selected path is MISSING; manifest and all remaining files equal original hashes

cases.mutation: In only the manifest's config_files/test.raw.json sha256 string, replace its leading 7 with 0. Original source files and the recorded byte count stay unchanged.
cases.expected_byte_relation: only manifest digest differs; source hashes remain original
cases.limitation: Ordinary file-to-manifest hashing can reject this case without any independent original pin. It cannot by itself demonstrate resistance to coherent manifest rebinding.

cases.mutation: Append one LF byte to copied config_files/test.raw.json. In the copied manifest update only that record's sha256 to the actual changed-byte digest and bytes to 880777. Keep revision, URLs and all other records unchanged.
cases.expected_byte_relation: raw file and manifest hashes differ from original; changed manifest record is internally consistent with changed file; the other three source hashes remain original
cases.why_decisive: The task JSON meaning and deterministic counts remain unchanged by a trailing newline, and all mutable manifest file checks agree. Only an independent original identity constraint can reject this coherent rebind. The expected failure is fixed here before any audit output exists.

cases.mutation: Remove only the evaluation_harness/helper_functions.py record from the copied manifest, retaining the helper file unchanged and the manifest as valid JSON.
cases.expected_byte_relation: manifest digest differs; all four source hashes remain original
cases.scope: Challenges treating the changed manifest's keys as the complete required-file population; this is a manifest integrity failure, not an absent physical source file.

cases.mutation: Make only the copied manifest absent; preserve all original source files and selection bytes.
cases.expected_byte_relation: manifest is MISSING; all source hashes remain original

restoration_design.source_snapshot_policy: Never modify the lane snapshot, another worktree, the Git index or jj state. Every input mutation occurs in this seat's scratch or an explicitly assigned new isolated copy.
restoration_design.restore_rule: Use preserved original bytes, not regenerated JSON/Python/manifest serialization. Restore in a finally-equivalent cleanup even on timeout or failure. Before proceeding, every touched file's restored hash must equal its before hash and the independent original pin.
restoration_design.code_mutation_rule: If a code mutation is later assigned, record and restore the exact runner bytes too, and run the same fixed bounded detector suite on pristine, mutated and restored runner bytes.

actual_execution.restoration_evidence: No source or instrument bytes changed; no restoration event is claimed. Only this new scratch expectation artifact and the assigned report were written.
